description: Local Codex and Claude running counts, attention and app RAM from Ocelin.

required.reason: Runs this read-only PowerShell provider with normal user rights because the sandbox cannot read Ocelin's local summary file. The host does not sandbox process providers.
Reads only Ocelin's opt-in aggregate counts and memory totals, without session names, project paths, prompts or account data.
Refreshes the summary every two seconds while this widget is enabled.
